verses.text: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in any wrongdoing, you who are led by the Spirit should gently help them get back on track. Watch yourself too, so you aren't tempted.
Carry one another's burdens, and in this way you'll fulfill Christ's law.
If anyone thinks they're important when they're not, they're fooling themselves.
Each person should examine their own work. Then they can take pride in their own actions, without comparing themselves to someone else.
Each person will carry their own load.
Anyone who is taught the word should share all good things with their teacher.
Don't fool yourselves: God can't be mocked. A person harvests whatever they plant.
Those who plant for their human nature will harvest decay from it. Those who plant for the Spirit will harvest eternal life from the Spirit.
Let's not get tired of doing good. At the right time we'll harvest a crop if we don't give up.
So whenever we have the opportunity, let's do good to everyone, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.
Look at the large letters I'm using as I write this greeting in my own hand.
Those who want to make a good impression by human standards are pressuring you to be circumcised. They do it only to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.
Even those who are circumcised don't keep the law themselves. They want you circumcised so they can brag about your bodies.
But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Through that cross, the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
In Christ Jesus, circumcision or uncircumcision means nothing. What matters is being made new.
Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule, and to God's Israel.
From now on, don't let anyone trouble me, because I carry on my body the marks of Jesus.
Brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
